name: science-resource-gap-system
description: Science Resource Gap Assessment and Intervention Tracking System

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix "[{name}]" --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "cyan,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
